If that's the case, then the center tile can NEVER be white. So the goal can't be "make all purple-dot tiles white".
Maybe the goal is different. Let me think about what patterns are possible:
- Cross tiles: W (white) - 3-state cycle tiles
- Center: g or N - 2-state cycle tile
- Corners: g or N - 2-state cycle tiles
The left panel has purple dots at cross + center positions. Maybe the goal is to have:
- Cross tiles: W (already done)
- Center: N (green) - the only non-gray state for 2-state tiles
- Corners: g (gray) - already done
That would mean I need to click the center once to make it N (green).
Let me try that and see if the level completes.
Actually wait, the current state already has center = g. So I need to click it once to make it N.
But earlier, when I had center = N, the level didn't complete. Let me check...
Actually, I'm not sure if I ever had the state: cross=W, center=N, corners=g. Let me check the history.
Looking back, at one point I had:
- Cross tiles: W
- Center: N
- Corner (49, 24): N (accidentally clicked)
- Other corners: g
So the state was close but not quite right because one corner was N.
Now the state is:
- Cross tiles: W
- Center: g
- All corners: g
If I click the center once, I get:
- Cross tiles: W
- Center: N
- All corners: g
This matches the purple dot pattern (cross+center are non-gray). Let me try this.
